The protocol says: "Each universe has ≤65536 windows, and their sizes sum to ≤131072/batch". So 6 jobs × 65536 max = 393216, but the sum must be ≤131072. So at most 2 jobs with 65536 windows.

Still, my test with 6 jobs × ~692k windows each is way out of spec. Let me build an in-spec worst case: sum of universe sizes ≤ 131072. E.g., 2 jobs with 65536 each, or 6 jobs with ~21845 each.
